outcome: Cardiac size (left atrial diameter, left ventricular diameter in diastole, left ventricular mass)
cohort: The study included 40 women: 20 pregnant women with sickle cell anemia (HbSS) and 20 pregnant women without sickle cell anemia (HBAA) as controls.
finding: Women with sickle cell anemia experienced a decrease in cardiac size (left atrial diameter, left ventricular diameter, and left ventricular mass) in the postpartum period compared to late pregnancy, though cardiac function remained unchanged in both groups.
